description: The ATO Template Library: a DoD SAP / JSIG template set for instruction and practice, arranged by RMF step. Hosted files are unclassified templates with personal metadata removed; adapted files are generalized for training; restricted items are described but not posted. Review every six months.
edition: JSIG 11 April 2016 (NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 4, CNSSI 1253 2014) with errata of 5 October 2018

groups.title: Start here
groups.note: The package checklist is the index for everything below. Read the JSIG and the program manager's handbook before filling in any template.

groups.title: Prepare
groups.note: Who does the work and under what procedures: appointments, the SAP SOP and training records.

groups.title: Categorize
groups.note: Decide the system's confidentiality, integrity and availability impact, its overlays and whether it is a national security system.

groups.title: Select
groups.note: Choose and tailor the controls. The SCTM is the record of that choice, from baseline to test result.

groups.title: Implement
groups.note: The SSP and the plans and procedures attached to it.

groups.title: Assess
groups.note: Plan the assessment, record the results and turn findings into risk.

groups.title: Authorize
groups.note: The POA&M and the documents that lead to the authorizing official's decision.

groups.title: Monitor
groups.note: Keep the authorization current: continuous monitoring, change review and self-inspection.

groups.title: Decommission
groups.note: Retire the system: the authorization ends, and media and hardware are sanitized or destroyed.

groups.title: Reference shelf
groups.note: The policies these templates come from. Read them; nothing here replaces them.

templates.title: ATO and ATC Package Checklist
templates.source: Adapted for training from a DoD SAP component checklist (February 2025)
templates.note: Every artifact an authorizing official expects in an ATO package, and the shorter list for an Authorization to Connect. Office names were removed; use it as the index for this library.

templates.title: DoD Joint SAP Implementation Guide (JSIG)
templates.source: DoD, 11 April 2016, with errata of 5 October 2018
templates.note: The cybersecurity rules every template here follows. Built on NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 4 and CNSSI 1253 (2014). No Rev. 5 JSIG or successor had been published as of October 2026.

templates.title: DoD SAP Program Manager's Handbook to the JSIG and the RMF
templates.note: A plain-language walk through the SAP RMF steps, roles and artifacts, written for program managers.

templates.title: ISSM / ISSO Appointment Letter
templates.source: DoD JSCS Working Group template, 22 January 2016 (53Rev4); references updated February 2025
templates.note: Appoints the ISSM or ISSO and records their DoDM 8140.03 qualifications. Add the ISSE if your package checklist asks for one.

templates.title: SAP Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Template
templates.source: DoD SAP Working Group, posted by DCSA
templates.note: The program SOP, including its automated information systems chapter. Procedure controls in the SCTM point here.

templates.title: SAP Training Record Template
templates.source: DoD SAP Working Group, posted by DCSA, March 2021
templates.note: Initial, annual and event-driven SAP training by topic, cybersecurity included. Evidence for the awareness and training controls.

templates.title: DAF IT Categorization and Selection Checklist (ITCSC) v10.1
templates.source: Department of the Air Force (SAF/CN), 18 April 2024
templates.note: The Air Force form that records system identification, classification, NSS status, overlays, privacy and categorization. It is distributed on the Air Force RMF Knowledge Service (CAC), so it is described here rather than posted. v10.1 is the newest version found publicly referenced.

templates.title: CNSSI 1253, Categorization and Control Selection for National Security Systems
templates.note: Separate confidentiality, integrity and availability values and the national security system baselines. The 2022 edition replaces the May 2014 baselines in the SCTM worksheet and adds built-in insider threat justifications.

templates.title: JSIG Appendix D: Confidentiality Impact Level Flowchart
templates.note: A decision flowchart for a SAP system's confidentiality impact level.

templates.title: DD Form 2930, Privacy Impact Assessment
templates.note: The privacy assessment the categorization checklist's privacy section calls for, and the source of the Privacy Overlay decision.

templates.title: SCTM Worksheet (53Rev4) with Overlays
templates.source: DoD JSCS Working Group, 1 February 2025 edition; sanitized for public release
templates.note: The SCTM workbook with CNSSI 1253 (May 2014) baselines, JSIG guidance, the Classified (May 2014) and Privacy (April 2015) overlays, and the CNSSI 1253 Appendix D insider threat and common control columns. Overlays that are CAC-only or could not be verified as publicly released were removed; see the two entries below.

templates.title: CNSSI 1253E Attachment 5: Classified System Overlay
templates.note: The current classified overlay. It replaces the May 2014 Classified Overlay in the SCTM worksheet; compare the two when teaching the move to Rev. 5.

templates.title: CNSS Intelligence Overlay and Cross Domain Solution Overlay
templates.note: Marked FOUO in the CNSS library and available only with a CAC or PKI login, so their columns were removed from the SCTM worksheet. Apply them only when your categorization calls for them, using your ISSM's copy.

templates.title: JSIG Accessibility, Isolated LAN and Standalone overlays
templates.note: The JSIG names these scenarios but does not publish the overlays' control selections, and no official public copy was found, so their columns were removed from the SCTM worksheet. Get the current versions from your ISSM or PSO.

templates.title: Waiver Request From Security Criteria
templates.source: DoD SAP Working Group, posted by DCSA
templates.note: How a deviation from a security requirement is requested and approved, including for controls a SAP system cannot tailor out.

templates.title: System Security Plan (SSP)
templates.source: DoD JSCS Working Group template, 14 January 2016 (53Rev4)
templates.note: The JSIG SSP, with sections for system identification, boundary, roles and SAP procedures such as periods processing and dormant hard drives. Attach the topology, hardware and software lists and the SCTM.

templates.title: Hardware List, Software List and Network Topology
templates.source: DCSA DAAPM v2.2, Appendices F, G and H
templates.note: Formats for the SSP's hardware and software lists and topology diagram. The DAAPM was written for cleared industry and DCSA has since replaced it with the DAAG (NISP eMASS only), but these formats remain good models.

templates.title: Configuration Management Plan
templates.source: NIST SP 800-128, Appendices D, E and H
templates.note: A sample CM plan outline (Appendix D), change request (Appendix E) and configuration control board charter (Appendix H). No SAP-specific CM plan template is public.

templates.title: Incident Response Plan and spill procedures
templates.source: DCSA DAAPM v2.2 Appendices Q and R; CDSE SAP Security Incidents job aid
templates.note: An incident response plan template and classified spill cleanup procedures, with CDSE's guide to SAP security incidents.

templates.title: Assured File Transfer (AFT) and data transfer procedures
templates.source: JSIG data transfer controls; DCSA DAAPM v2.2 Appendix O
templates.note: How data moves on and off the system by removable media under two-person, reviewed procedures. Component AFT SOPs are internal; DAAPM Appendix O is the closest public model.

templates.title: Media Protection policy and procedures
templates.note: Write these from the JSIG's MP family and its SAP values. No standalone public template exists.

templates.title: Ports, Protocols and Services Management (PPSM) matrix
templates.note: Lists every port, protocol and service the system uses. The DoD PPSM registry and its templates need a CAC; build a simple matrix (port, protocol, service, direction, boundary, justification) for training.

templates.title: Contingency Plan and Business Impact Analysis
templates.note: NIST's contingency plan templates for low, moderate and high impact systems, and its business impact analysis template.

templates.title: Interconnection agreements (ISA, MOU/A)
templates.source: NIST SP 800-47 Rev. 1, Appendix C; DCSA DAAPM v2.2 Appendix U
templates.note: Agreement templates for systems that exchange information. Needed for an Authorization to Connect.

templates.title: Security Assessment Plan (format reference)
templates.source: FedRAMP Rev5 template (legacy), with NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5
templates.note: No public SAP assessment plan template exists. FedRAMP's shows the expected structure; pair it with the SP 800-53A assessment procedures.

templates.title: Security Assessment Report (format reference)
templates.note: SAP SARs are produced in SAP eMASS. FedRAMP's SAR and risk exposure table show the same parts for teaching.

templates.title: Risk Assessment Report (RAR)
templates.source: JSIG RAR template, C&A Transformation Working Group
templates.note: A Tier 3 risk assessment following NIST SP 800-30, updated after testing. Include the risk from controls that are not implemented or are tailored out.

templates.title: Vulnerability and STIG compliance scans
templates.source: DoD Cyber Exchange: STIG library, STIG Viewer and SCAP Compliance Checker
templates.note: The package needs credentialed vulnerability scans summarizing CAT I, II and III findings, and STIG compliance scans. These are the public STIGs and tools for practice.

templates.title: SAP RMF Cybersecurity Compliance Checklist v1.1
templates.source: DoD SAP Working Group, posted by DCSA, 17 November 2017
templates.note: JSIG checks by control family, including the controls a SAP system cannot tailor out. Inspectors ask for it when an organization runs its own SAP systems.

templates.title: Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M)
templates.source: DoD JSCS Working Group, JSIG-based, 19 January 2016 (53Rev3 and Rev4)
templates.note: Every weakness with its control, point of contact, resources, milestones and risk level, plus a completed-items sheet and column instructions. Signed by the program manager for the package.

templates.title: System Validation Memorandum
templates.note: Confirms the system as built matches the package. No public template exists; write a one-page memo that names the system, boundary and package date, signed by the ISSM and program manager.

templates.title: Authorization decision letters (ATO, ATO with conditions, IATT, ATC)
templates.source: DoDI 8510.01 decision types; templates on the RMF Knowledge Service
templates.note: DoD's decision letter templates are on the CAC-only RMF Knowledge Service. DoDI 8510.01 defines the decision types; the decommissioning DATO in this library shows the memo format.

templates.title: Letter of Assurance / Request to Interconnect
templates.note: A memo from the information system owner of each boundary, needed for an Authorization to Connect. No public template exists.

templates.title: Continuous Monitoring Strategy
templates.note: Vulnerability scanning, audit review, POA&M review, annual assessment and configuration management, with a continuous monitoring report section.

templates.title: Security Impact Analysis
templates.note: A template for analyzing a change before it is made. The ATC checklist requires one.

templates.title: SAP Security Compliance Inspection Checklist
templates.source: DoD SAP Working Group (January 2026); CDSE edition (September 2026)
templates.note: The questions SAP inspections ask, for self-inspection between assessments.

templates.title: Denial of Authorization to Operate (DATO) to Support Decommissioning
templates.source: Adapted for training from a DoD SAP component memo (March 2025)
templates.note: Ends a system's authorization so it can be decommissioned. Office names, people and contact details were replaced with placeholders.

templates.title: Sanitization Plan Review Checklist
templates.note: Marked not releasable outside its issuing office, so it is not posted. It reviews a sanitization package: device, disposition type, dual authorization, the Certificate of Volatility, Mission Impact Memorandum and procedures. Use NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2 and NSA/CSS Policy Manual 9-12 to teach the same steps.

templates.title: Mission Impact Memorandum (MIM)
templates.note: Accepts the mission impact of a disposition. Signed by the government program manager, PSO, AODR and AO. No public template exists.

templates.title: Certificate of Volatility (COV)
templates.note: The manufacturer's statement of each memory component in a device and whether it keeps data without power. Request it from the vendor for each make and model.

templates.title: SAP Transportation Plan Template
templates.note: Plans the approved movement of SAP hardware or media, for example to a destruction facility.

templates.title: DoD Manual 5205.07, Special Access Program Security Manual
templates.note: Requires the JSIG, or its successor, for SAP cybersecurity.

templates.title: DoD Instruction 5205.11, Management, Administration, and Oversight of DoD SAPs
templates.note: The SAP oversight instruction cited in the appointment letter and DATO.

templates.title: DoD Instruction 8510.01, Risk Management Framework for DoD Systems
templates.note: Defines the authorization package and the decision types.

templates.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and SP 800-53A Rev. 5 (Release 5.2.0)
templates.note: The Rev. 5 controls and assessment procedures to map the Rev. 4 JSIG templates against.

templates.title: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 and SP 800-137
templates.note: The risk assessment method behind the RAR and the continuous monitoring guidance behind the ConMon strategy.
